Is "LLM Evals" considered a separate job profile in the market?

No. LLM evals are not a separate job profile; they are part of AI engineering. If you become an AI engineer you’ll learn how LLM evals work so you can properly evaluate a system before deployment. It’s important for industry, though few people currently focus on it.
what is the different between online and offline evals

Offline eval is done before deployment using labeled (golden) data and known answers to test your system. It cannot catch many production risks.

Online eval runs after deployment on live production traffic. It works without answers or a golden data set, monitors real user interactions, and can sample a subset (e.g., 1,000 conversations) to reduce cost. Online eval catches production issues that offline eval cannot.

They are not rivals but complementary: use offline eval to test models before release and online eval to monitor and validate behavior in production.
